name: seamtrail
description: SeamTrail, your team's shared memory, in Claude Code: each chat asks once which SeamTrail project it is for, then gets that project's context, the news that touches its own work, and at every message the latest memory about the tickets you name and what the message is about — found from a hint cut from that message on your computer, with no code, secrets or credentials — saves only into it, keeps a cleaned cut of what you asked and what Claude did in each message as the chat's history, and is reminded at turn end to save what was decided.

seamtrail_token.title: SeamTrail token
seamtrail_token.description: Make one in SeamTrail: Settings → Agents · MCP connector → Token → Make a token (the Plugins tab's Claude Code steps take you there). It works as you; revoke it there any time.

seamtrail_url.title: SeamTrail address
seamtrail_url.description: Leave it as it is, unless your company runs its own SeamTrail.
